prompts.logo:
Use case: logo-brand. Edit this Ventlore logo into a crisp printed flat-color logo on a FULLY OPAQUE SOLID WARM WHITE background, #F5F1E8. No transparency anywhere. The entire rectangular background must be light cream from edge to edge.
Keep the exact logo concept and exact lowercase word "ventlore": two open pages suggesting a V, a winding path cut into the right page, an ochre circular waypoint. Keep the symbol shape and wordmark typeface.
Every letter and green shape must be opaque uniform dark green #173F35, absolutely no glow or halo, no atmospheric effects, no shading. Circle is solid warm ochre #F0A44B. The winding path is the same light cream as the background, clearly visible in negative space. Visually like a vector logo printed in two spot inks on clean ivory paper, but no paper texture. High contrast. Layout wide centered horizontal lockup, generous margins. The only text is "ventlore". This is a clean production logo image, no mockup.
prompts.avatar:
Use case: logo-brand
Reference: the attached primary Ventlore logo. Preserve the icon EXACTLY: two book/map panels forming a V, vertical negative-space spine, winding path carved through the right panel, one circular waypoint in the upper right. Remove the wordmark and keep ONLY that identical symbol.
Create a premium standalone app icon / social avatar on a completely opaque solid dark forest square background #173F35. The two panels must be warm ivory #F5F1E8 and the small waypoint dot warm amber #F0A44B. The path and central division are background dark green. Flat vector-style edges, no texture, no glow, no shadows, no gradient, no added border, no rounded-corner frame, no text, no modifications to the shape. Square 1024x1024 composition.
prompts.reverse:

prompts.board:
Use case: logo-brand / product-mockup.
Create a beautiful, refined Ventlore visual identity presentation board, editorial landscape 3:2, large high-resolution. Reference image 1 is the exact primary logo, reference image 2 the matching reverse icon. Preserve this identity exactly, use the very same book-V / winding path / amber dot symbol and lowercase wordmark, never redesign it.
Brand: outdoor discovery with knowledge shared by local people. Warm, considered, useful, adventurous. Palette: deep forest #173F35, jade #2C7563, soft sage #DCE8DA, warm ivory #F5F1E8, waypoint amber #F0A44B, charcoal #182522. Use ivory, forest and sage as large areas; amber only tiny accents.
Art direction: sophisticated Swiss editorial grid with 5 or 6 spacious asymmetric panels, ample breathing space, contemporary rounded humanist sans typography, thin topographic contour lines as a subtle secondary graphic in some panels. Main upper-left hero panel large ivory with exact Ventlore logo. Under logo exact tagline "Know the place. Find your way." Small quiet eyebrow "VISUAL IDENTITY / 01".
Other panels: a close-up realistically photographed natural canvas field tote with green logo and small amber dot, a deep forest field notebook with ivory logo, refined small round trail-community stickers featuring the exact symbol; an ivory digital discovery-page mockup with "Know the place." heading, "Explore places" button and scenic coast photo, clearly editorial not a technical spec; a typography and palette strip with short text "Local knowledge. Shared horizons." and five simple solid swatches. Tiny label "CONCEPT" on the interface. No safety badges, no verified place claims.
Background photography on one small panel: natural calm green coastal headland and ocean, documentary daylight, no people necessary. Product mockups should look tactile and real.
Readable restrained labels only, no lengthy body text or invented data. Avoid busy moodboard, generic corporate template, tech neon, gradients, cryptocurrency symbols, mountains icon, shield, emergency imagery, multiple alternative logos. Layout must look like one coherent professional branding case study.
